summary: Sample data, not a model result. For the week ending 2026-08-16, the sample model estimates U.S. corn yield at 183.0 bu/acre (range 177.0 to 187.8) and soybeans at 51.4 bu/acre (range 49.4 to 53.0).
bullets: Corn: the sample estimate is 0.4 bu/acre below the August 2026 Crop Production figure of 183.4 bu/acre.
Soybeans: the sample estimate is 1.1 bu/acre below the August 2026 Crop Production figure of 52.5 bu/acre.
